import re, urllib.request, sys
url='https://bis.zju.edu.cn/uuatac/download.html'
txt=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}),timeout=120).read().decode('utf-8','replace')
hrefs=re.findall(r'href=["\x27]([^"\x27]+)',txt,re.I)
keep=[h for h in hrefs if any(x in h.lower() for x in ['axolotl','bigwig','.bw','figshare','geo','gse'])]
with open('links.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(f'html_bytes={len(txt)} hrefs={len(hrefs)} kept={len(keep)}\n')
    f.write('\n'.join(keep))
